# MLApplications

> MLApplications is a Windows software developer and publisher, distributing desktop applications through the Microsoft Store and via mlapplications.com. The company builds practical utility and creative apps for Windows, focused on productivity, media, communication, and personalization.

MLApplications develops native Windows apps using C# WPF and MSIX/Desktop Bridge packaging, with some products incorporating AI-driven features (e.g. AI video/talking-head generation, on-device inference).

## Apps

- [ImTalking](https://mlapplications.com/imtalking): AI-powered talking avatar / talking photo app that animates a photo to speak using text or audio input. Runs on Windows desktop, does not need special gpu and keeps your ideas inside your computer. nothing is stored outside your computer. It is completely free without any limitations.
- [Transparent Taskbar+](https://mlapplications.com/transparent-taskbar): Customizes and adds transparency/theming effects to the Windows taskbar. it is free without any cost. users can make their windows 11 taskbar transparent or brush only the icons list as a dock. it is free and does not make any change in the registry.
- [Desktop Live Wallpaper+](https://mlapplications.com/desktop-live-wallpaper): Sets animated and interactive live wallpapers on the Windows desktop. use your videos and make them play as a desktop background. supports fantastic transition effects from media to media.
- [Screen Recorder+](https://mlapplications.com/screen-recorder): Records the screen, webcam, and audio on Windows with editing and export options and with or without the cursor move.
- [DVD Player+](https://mlapplications.com/dvd-player): Plays DVDs and Blu-Ray discs on modern Windows systems that lack built-in DVD playback. completely free without any limitation.
- [AI Video Upscaler+](https://mlapplications.com/ai_videoupscaler_plus.html): Free AI video upscaler and frame interpolator for Windows. Upscales old or low-resolution videos to 2K, 4K or 8K, converts 24–30 fps to 45 or 60 fps, and restores faces with GFPGAN. Every AI model runs locally; works on ordinary Intel, AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, including integrated graphics.
- [unReachable](https://mlapplications.com/unreachable): Windows utility app (see product page for current feature set) where you can track with one number only in your taskbar the quality of your network connection.

## Transparent Taskbar+ Lite

Free taskbar customizer for Windows 11 and Windows 10 (Microsoft Store ID 9P7HB1KDTTT8). Makes the taskbar transparent, tinted, blurred or acrylic, and adds styles TranslucentTB does not have: a border line (none, thin or thick, automatic or custom colour), one- and two-colour gradients, 50+ patterns, your own picture as the background (fill, stretch, tile, center, opacity, backing colour), glass or coloured buttons and docks behind app icons, a dock-style icon magnifier (the icon under the mouse grows, on by default), and mouse effects (taskbar highlight, click bubbles, mouse light). One line, one background and one button style are combined. Works with top, bottom, left and right taskbars and multiple monitors. Settings open in the app window or in a browser and preview each change on the real taskbar for 5 seconds.

- [Overview and TranslucentTB comparison](https://mlapplications.com/transparent_taskbar_windows.html)
- [Help & How-To](https://mlapplications.com/hlp_ttbplus.html)
- [Effects Guide](https://mlapplications.com/hlp_ttbplus_effects.html)
- [Tips & Tricks](https://mlapplications.com/hlp_ttbplus_tipsnandtricks.html)
- [Privacy](https://mlapplications.com/ttbplus_privacy.html)
- [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P7HB1KDTTT8)

## Video samples

Real, unedited results from the apps, rendered on an ordinary laptop (Intel Core i7-11800H, Intel UHD integrated graphics, 16 GB RAM, no dedicated GPU); each clip took about 10–12 minutes.

- [AI Video Upscaler+ before/after samples](https://mlapplications.com/ai_videoupscaler_plus_videos_samples.html): 720p to 4K, 30 fps to 60 fps, GFPGAN face restoration on/off, and an old 640×480 phone video upscaled to 2160p at 60 fps.
- [ImTalking talking-avatar samples](https://mlapplications.com/imtalking_videos_samples.html): talking-avatar videos generated from a single photo, comparing GFPGAN enhancement, 512 vs 1024 px upscale and still mode on/off.
